name: OI-flush capitulation V-bounce (5m fast-trigger spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (H1 on a faster bar): the same forced-deleveraging exhaustion, but on 5m to catch the instant the liquidation ladder is consumed — the V-bounce off a cascade forms in minutes, so a slower bar can miss the best entry. The counterparty is a price-insensitive risk engine dumping into a thin book; once the marginal forced long is liquidated there is no more forced sell, and the non-economic seller's absence IS the mean-reversion. Entry: open_interest cross_down through a fitted floor (the flush) AND ret_Nd below a negative floor over a very short lookback (price falling NOW) AND rsi below an oversold floor AND vol_realized above a floor (violent regime). DISCONFIRMER: ablate the open_interest arm — if rsi-oversold + ret_Nd-down alone matches the deflated Sharpe, OI is redundant and this is plain oversold-bounce; and flip ret_Nd to UP — a still-profitable long means the OI sign is noise. On 5m the round-trip fee drag is heavier, so the V must clear ~20bps net with margin.
catalyst: 5m OI cross_down flush + falling price + oversold — fast forced-seller exhaustion
